rationale: The Latin anchors (expandi manus meas ad te, ad te levavi animam meam, ad te levavi oculos meos, exaltabit caput) all point to the concrete, physical sense of lifting/raising hands, eyes, or the head upward, which maps directly to raise.v.02 ("raise from a lower to a higher position"). The example "Raise your hands" is a near-perfect parallel to the Biblical/poetic contexts attested.
